method: over _run/s9/adjudications.jsonl (2331 rows, incl. 2 P5-reconstructed): every DISMISSED must carry a non-empty reason (adjudicated_holding|reason|dismiss_reason). Per-lane refute/dismiss signal = join votes.jsonl panel-lane verdict x final adjudication verdict; refute-precision = fraction of a lane's 'refuted' votes whose finding was finally DISMISSED; stands-precision = fraction of 'stands'/'stands-modified' votes finally UPHELD/MODIFIED. Prompt-tuning signal only (spec: never auto-suppression).

exceptions.note: codex-A is the conservative refuter (refute-rate 32.6%, refute-precision 97.7%) but stands-precision only 29.7% — most findings it lets 'stand' are dismissed by the 2-of-3 quorum; under-sensitive to false positives. codex-B most trigger-happy false-refuter (79.3% refute-precision, 302 refutes overruled). claude-opus-panel is the designed adversarial refuter (refute-rate 81.7%) and best-calibrated on both axes (92.4% / 79.8%). Tuning signal, not a defect.
